description: India Pavilion design & build for Gulfood 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre — an APEDA-style ~600 sqm national pavilion hosting 40+ Indian exporter co-exhibitors. Scope covers premium octanorm shell scheme plus custom hero fabrication, AV experience zones, signage/wayfinding, and a hospitality lounge. Project is mid-execution: fabrication and content production are underway with on-site build approaching.

tasks.title: Pavilion master plan & hero zone GA drawings - 600 sqm
tasks.description: Approved floor plan locking 40+ co-exhibitor octanorm pods around the central hero arch, hospitality lounge and AV zone. Issued GA, sections and rigging plan to DWTC operations for approval.

tasks.title: Technical bid narrative & eligibility compliance matrix
tasks.description: Concept note and compliance matrix mapping APEDA tender clauses, DWTC build regulations and exporter eligibility against our submission. Signed off and filed in the bid dossier.

tasks.title: Submission dossier - EMD, tender fee & compliance checklist
tasks.description: Compiled EMD bank guarantee, tender-fee receipt and signed compliance checklist; submitted the full dossier to APEDA and confirmed acknowledgement.

tasks.title: Custom hero arch & lounge fabrication - vendor build
tasks.description: GA & fabrication drawings released; coordinating with the Dubai fabrication vendor on the custom hero arch, premium lounge counters and material samples. On-site build slot at DWTC confirmed.

tasks.title: Pavilion signage, wayfinding & 40+ co-exhibitor fascia
tasks.description: Producing the bilingual fascia name boards, directional wayfinding and hero backdrop graphics for all exporter pods, applying APEDA brand guidelines and print-ready bleed specs.

tasks.title: Hero LED wall content & 90s India Pavilion brand film
tasks.description: Editing the 90-second brand film and looping LED wall content showcasing Indian agri-export categories for the central screen and lounge displays. First cut in review with audio mix pending.

tasks.title: 3D pavilion walkthrough animation for client preview
tasks.description: Camera-mapped 3D walkthrough animation of the full 600 sqm pavilion built from the approved GA, used for the APEDA stakeholder preview. Rendered draft submitted for sign-off.

tasks.title: Co-exhibitor profile content & lounge collateral copy
tasks.description: Writing and QC-ing the 40+ exporter profile blurbs, lounge brochure copy and category storyboards. Draft routed for content sign-off before handing to graphics.

tasks.title: On-site build master timeline & deliverable tracker
tasks.description: Maintaining the day-by-day build, dressing and exhibitor handover schedule synced with DWTC move-in dates and tracking all team deliverables against milestones.

tasks.title: AV & lighting rig BOQ - awaiting Dubai vendor quote
tasks.description: Finalising the BOQ and costing for AV screens, LED wall and lounge lighting; blocked pending the revised quote from the Dubai AV vendor and client approval on the premium fixtures.

description: Permanent G20 legacy exhibition at Bharat Mandapam, ITPO Pragati Maidan, New Delhi, commemorating India's G20 presidency through immersive zones, projection mapping, and a curated narrative walk. Execution is complete and the build has gone through one rework round; deliverables are now consolidated for Vertical Head sign-off ahead of handover.

tasks.description: Finalized GA and fabrication drawings for all five immersive zones (approx. 1,200 sqm) including projection-mapping surface geometry and curated narrative-walk circulation. As-built set reconciled against on-site build for VH review.

tasks.title: Projection-mapping rig alignment fix - rework round
tasks.description: Re-survey and re-render of the central dome projection surface after VH flagged keystone distortion on the curved wall; updating GA detail and vendor alignment spec for the AV install team.

tasks.title: Final BOQ & vendor cost reconciliation
tasks.description: Closed-out BOQ for fabrication, lighting, and projection hardware with vendor invoices reconciled against estimate; variance note prepared for delivery handover.

tasks.title: Narrative-walk graphic panels & wayfinding - print-ready set
tasks.description: Print-ready artwork for the curated narrative-walk panels, zone identifiers, and bilingual (Hindi/English) wayfinding signage matching the G20 legacy brand palette. Pre-press files released to fabrication.

tasks.title: VH presentation deck - exhibition walkthrough & sign-off pack
tasks.description: Vertical Head review deck compiling zone renders, projection-mapping stills, and as-built photos into a single walkthrough narrative for final sign-off.

tasks.title: Curated narrative-walk content & zone concept notes - QC sign-off
tasks.description: Final editorial pass on the G20 presidency narrative copy across all zones, with concept notes and a compliance check against the ITPO content guidelines. QC sign-off logged for VH review.

tasks.title: Delivery dossier & deliverable tracker - handover prep
tasks.description: Consolidated handover dossier with master timeline, deliverable tracker, sign-off log, and ITPO compliance checklist assembled for Vertical Head approval before client delivery.

description: Custom OEM pavilion for an automotive manufacturer at Bharat Mobility / Auto Expo 2026, India Expo Mart, Greater Noida. A double-decker fabricated structure featuring vehicle display turntables, an immersive LED feature wall, and a test-drive booking zone. Project delivered on-site and tender successfully awarded.

tasks.title: Double-decker pavilion 3D design - hero renders & GA drawings
tasks.description: Final 3D concept renders and general arrangement drawings for the ~18m x 15m double-decker OEM pavilion, including upper-deck lounge, vehicle display bays and circulation flow approved by the client.

tasks.description: Detailed fabrication & GA drawings, structural BOQ and costing for two motorised vehicle turntables and the LED feature wall frame; coordinated steel, carpentry and LED vendors for on-site mobilisation.

tasks.title: On-site build & handover - test-drive booking zone
tasks.description: Supervised on-site fabrication, installation and snagging of the test-drive booking zone and upper-deck build at India Expo Mart, completing final handover to the client before show open.

tasks.title: LED feature wall content - 3D brand walkthrough loop
tasks.description: Produced a 120s synchronised LED feature-wall content loop with a 3D pavilion walkthrough animation and OEM brand film, mastered to the wall's native resolution and aspect ratio.

tasks.title: Submission dossier - EMD, tender fee & compliance checklist
tasks.description: Compiled and submitted the full bid dossier including EMD, tender-fee documents, compliance checklist and master deliverable timeline; tracked award confirmation and post-delivery client sign-off.

description: Design and fabrication of a state tableau (jhanki) for the Republic Day 2026 parade on Kartavya Path, New Delhi, responding to a Ministry of Culture tender. Scope covered theme concept and narrative, a scaled tractor-trailer tableau model with moving/kinetic elements, and costume and prop coordination for performing artists. The bid was completed and the final outcome dossier submitted to the client.

tasks.title: Tableau theme concept note & cultural narrative
tasks.description: Authored the bilingual (Hindi/English) theme concept note framing the state's cultural heritage story for the 45ft tableau, with the front-portion and trailer narrative beats aligned to Ministry of Culture brief.

tasks.title: Scaled tableau model - hero render & GA drawings
tasks.description: Produced the 1:10 scaled physical model plus 3D hero renders and general arrangement drawings for the 45ft x 14ft tractor-trailer tableau, detailing platform, elevation profile and sightlines for parade review.

tasks.title: Moving elements - kinetic mechanism & fabrication drawings
tasks.description: Engineered the rotating centrepiece and articulated moving figures with hydraulic/motorised mechanism specs, structural load calcs and fabrication drawings for on-trailer assembly within parade height limits.

tasks.title: Costume & prop coordination - artist styling & on-trailer props
tasks.description: Coordinated costume design and prop fabrication for the 12 performing artists on the tableau, including handcrafted regional attire, headgear and ceremonial props matched to the cultural theme.

tasks.title: Tableau graphic panels & decorative motif artwork
tasks.description: Designed the side-panel mural artwork, decorative cultural motifs and state-name signage as print-ready vector files scaled for vinyl wrap and FRP cladding on the tableau body.

tasks.title: Submission dossier - presentation deck & compliance pack
tasks.description: Compiled the final Ministry of Culture submission dossier: pitch presentation deck, annotated renders, model photographs and the theme-justification compliance pack delivered to the client.
